bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నిన్ను ఆశీర్వదించి నిన్ను కాపాడునుగాక; యెహోవా నీకు తన సన్నిధిని ప్రకాశింపజేసి నిన్ను కరుణించునుగాక; యెహోవా నీమీద తన సన్నిధి కాంతి ఉదయింపజేసి నీకు సమాధానము కలుగజేయును  గాక.
bible_verses.english: The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.

bible_verses.telugu: భూమిమీద నీ మార్గము తెలియబడునట్లును అన్యజనులందరిలో నీ రక్షణ తెలియబడునట్లును
bible_verses.english: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine on us.

bible_verses.telugu: సమాధానకర్తయగు ప్రభువు తానే యెల్లప్పుడును ప్రతి విధముచేతను మీకు సమాధానము అనుగ్రహించును గాక. ప్రభువు మీకందరికి తోడైయుండును గాక.
bible_verses.english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, thank You for shining Your light and grace upon me today. Turn my eyes to see Your favor, and anchor my restless heart in Your perfect peace. Help me to rest securely in Your keeping, knowing that Your presence goes before me and surrounds me. May the blessing I receive from You overflow into the lives of those around me. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, thank You for shining Your light and grace upon me today. Turn my eyes to see Your favor, and anchor my restless heart in Your perfect peace. Help me to rest securely in Your keeping, knowing that Your presence goes before me and surrounds me. May the blessing I receive from You overflow into the lives of those around me. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: These timeless words carry the tender heart of the Father over your life today. When God turns His face toward you, He isn't looking with judgment, but with overwhelming grace, love, and favor. Resting in His blessing reminds us that our security and peace don't depend on our circumstances, but on His constant presence. As you sing this ancient prayer, let your heart soften and receive the deep, restoring peace that Christ freely gives.
